message: **An unreadable MCP `tool_quotas[].rate.per` is refused at config load, and the quota counter map is bounded.** A `per:` value outside `ms / s / m / h / d` was never validated anywhere: `per: 1hour` compiled clean, `sbproxy validate` accepted it, and the request path then read the parse failure as "this tool has no quota" and let every `tools/call` through with no log line and no counter, so the dashboard showed the quota configured and zero rejections. The `mcp` action now refuses the config naming the policy, the tool, and the string; the request-path branch survives as a backstop and denies instead of allowing. Separately, the sliding-window store keyed on the caller-presented principal id and never evicted, so every distinct `sub` that called a quota'd tool once left a permanent entry. Aged-out windows are reclaimed now, and past 100,000 live windows a principal the store cannot track is refused rather than admitted unmetered. See [docs/config-stability.md](docs/config-stability.md) and [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md).
